rationale.consistency: Uses cmdutil.FlagErrorf, api.HandleHTTPError, safeurl, httpmock and the prescribed package layout; test.go helper has precedent (internal/prompter/test.go). Package-level openFile var and always-true KeepExistingBody field are slightly off-idiom.
rationale.edge_cases: Nine types, size limits, dir/non-regular/empty, os.SameFile dedupe, '#' in filenames, code spans, blockquote definitions, alt-text round-trip all handled. Partial upload still writes the body (requirement says nothing is written); issue edit silently drops --body when upload fails.
rationale.scope: Dead code: UploadResult, UploadStub, Flag.Count, telemetry assert helper with no emitter, ReplaceOperations computed then discarded; unrequested 50-attachment cap; KeepExistingBody field set true by every caller.
rationale.readability: Clear file roadmap and names, but comments are very prose-heavy; doc.go example uses result.Uploaded while the function returns an int; eight near-identical uploadErr join blocks.
rationale.robustness: Bounds checks in applyEdits/inlineRanges, GetBody for redirects, bodies closed, allowlists for token and permission, no panics on bad input. Failure semantics differ between create (returns error after write) and edit (drops body edit).
rationale.maintainability: errors.Join(uploadErr, err) duplicated across commands; hasOtherEdits duplicates hasDeferredFlags; edit-last text preservation relies on InputType zero value being Editor; 800-line hand-rolled position scanner on top of goldmark is a maintenance burden; stale doc comment.
